text: Can an AI recognise a video from just its colors? Meet Video Color Bench.
Shrink each moment of a video to its average color, and line them up as stripes.
Every barcode is a fingerprint. We made two hundred: one hundred films, and one hundred of the most viewed YouTube videos.
Nosferatu, from nineteen twenty two, flips between yellow for day and blue for night.
The model gets only the barcode and ten titles. No web search, no tools.
Five models tried it. Opus five point five and GPT six point one Sol did best, at about twenty six percent overall. Chance is ten.
Even the best model is right only about one time in four. Better than guessing, but far from solved.
